title: Take A Break - Rural
official: Using Rural Community Paramedicine to Engage Lower-Motivated Smokers: Spreading an Effective mHealth-Assisted Intervention to Motivate Cessation
summary: The study team proposes a multi-level trial to test 1) novel implementation programs in rural counties designed to increase access to 2) recent advances in tobacco control services for people who are not-yet-ready-to-quit smoking. In this field, most trials have focused only on those already ready-to-quit. Thus, the proposed trial addresses an important knowledge gap critical to advance tobacco control in rural areas.

interventions.name: Take a Break plus Nicotine replacement therapy (NRT) Sampling
Community Paramedicine Standard Plus Enhanced Implementation Program

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Current Smoker
* at least 18 years old
* speaks English
* Able to receive texts and read text (literate)
* Have a text-enabled phone or receive one from the study team
* Not yet ready to quit smoking

Exclusion Criteria:

* actively quitting smoking
* preparing to quit smoking within 30 days
* prisoners
* FDA- defined NRT contraindications
* unable or unwilling to provide informed consent
